title: IngestionConfig
description: Contract 4: configuration for document -> knowledge-graph ingestion. Turns documents into a graph without rewriting extraction pipelines per backend. The response is an IngestionReport whose counters are measured from the backend, never estimated.

protocol.description: The protocol version identifier. Must be 'graphrag/1.0'.

graph_id.description: Target graph identifier (TigerGraph graph name) to write into.

document_type.description: Document type driving the vertex/edge mapping (paper -> Paper/Author/Concept).

extraction.description: How entities/concepts are extracted from document text.

resolve.description: How extracted entities are matched against the existing graph.

max_concepts_per_doc.description: Upper bound on concepts extracted per document.

embed_documents.description: Also upsert into the PaperEmb vector vertex when embeddings are available.

dry_run.description: Extract and resolve but do not write; the report reflects what WOULD happen and the graph is left untouched.

ExtractionStrategy.description: frequency: deterministic stopword-filtered top-K tokens (no API). llm: Gemini concept extraction, degrading to frequency with a recorded reason on failure.

ResolveStrategy.description: exact_id: an existing vertex is matched by id and its attributes are refreshed by the upsert. new_only: insert-only, an existing document/entity is never overwritten.

Triple.description: A (subject, predicate, object) assertion extracted from a document.

predicate.description: Edge type, e.g. MENTIONS, AUTHORED_BY, CITES.

properties.description: Resolution metadata (e.g. resolved: true). Never written as edge attributes.

IngestionReport.description: Outcome of an ingest/update/delete call. Every counter is measured against the backend.

documents_created.description: Written ids that did not exist before this call.

documents_skipped.description: Documents left untouched (NEW_ONLY and already present).

vertices_before.description: Vertex counts per type before the call (measured).

vertices_after.description: Vertex counts per type after the call (measured).

errors.description: Per-document failure reasons; never silently swallowed.
